items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Steve Webb had seven guys arranging in Steve Webb's band. You know -- they had Teddy arrange, Gus arrange. Joe arranged. You know -- Joe Ellis.

ctx.x: Joe and I -- Teddy and Gus. Gus played trombone and was a very good arranger. He was a good trombone player too. He was an excellent arranger.
And then after that I joined Zack Way (PHONETIC).
